property_summary: Calling setOwner with a valid address as the admin returns true in the reference contract and false in the mutant.

After calling setOwner(address) with a non-admin address as argument, the reference sets owner to that argument, while the bug sets owner to admin; checking admin ownership via onlyOwner modifier on a subsequent call reveals the divergence.

After admin calls setOwner with a non-owner address, the reference sets owner to that address (so admin can no longer call onlyOwner functions), while the bug sets owner to admin (so admin can still call onlyOwner functions).
